registered_server.boundary: Authenticated token or web owner enters the durable FIFO; exact active scheduler/account/token is rechecked before dispatch and publication. Immutable claim/fence/license/ledger own metering; unknown process trees or measurements retain original work without result or invented zero.

web_project.boundary: Project ACL and durable actor bind asynchronous text/stem/Arranger/Remix/Studio work to the common registered owner. Old synchronous server generation is refused. Source preparation and non-ML DSP do not claim a separate AI measurement.

durable_remote.boundary: Original local inference/ledger claim, immutable signed CPU evidence and original request/worker binding feed publication/billing outboxes. Unknown receipts stay held, no local fallback/re-execution, and commercial unattested inference is denied.

pull_worker.boundary: Single pinned authority binds actor/ledger to original node credential, task, source, nonce and completion. HTTPS worker has private no-reexecution state; descendants/unavailable observation are not settled as measured. Physical multihost/kernel acceptance is separate B2/B6.

native_local.boundary: Explicit native single-user profile owns local execution; local actor zero cannot become a server actor or bill. Admitted model policy precedes source/worker dispatch; bounded supervision stops/reaps the worker. Native platform execution guarantees remain F5/G6.

native_remote.boundary: Explicit native profile and private user token submit/recover the original server request; no local fallback or second local bill. Local rights admission precedes transport. Original authenticated server ledger supplies counters; credentials are not returned to other users.

adapter_child.boundary: Trusted bundled adapter executes only inside its parent registered/native/operator launch boundary; it does not create its own bill. Server parent owns the exact ledger and process measurement; nested subprocesses need cgroup evidence or are held. Loaded-checkpoint/rights authenticity remains F3/F4/F6.

native_mobile.boundary: Device-local iOS Core ML is an explicit unbilled local operation under the native serial task, security-scoped source and temporary output. Server import separately authenticates the project owner and creates no remote AI usage. Android WebView invokes authenticated server APIs; it has no independent neural inference sink. Installed mobile NC/rights/hardware acceptance remains F5/G6.

operator_diagnostic.boundary: Installation/build/self-test/benchmark is explicitly launched by the authenticated administrator/native owner or local operating-system operator. It cannot submit a user-selected executable via inference API and never supplies user-billable usage. Model/GPU diagnostic success is not original rights or target acceptance.
